name: Clts286Stub
comment: 0F 06 CLTS — clear MSW.TS bit. Phase 26 v1 STUB. Real encoding requires 0x0F escape prefix support which lands in Sprint 26.2 (BlockDetector + DecoderTable need to recognize 0x0F as a two-byte-opcode prefix and dispatch the second byte through a separate code path). For now the spec entry exists with a placeholder mask of 0x0F + match 0x0F so it never matches a real instruction byte (no data byte equals 0x0F in the smoke tests we run today). The IR step references x86_clts_286_stub which is a no-op emitter; once Sprint 26.2 wires real 0F decoding + Sprint 26.3 ships proper system emitters, this format gets repointed to mask=0xFF match=0x06 + a 'requires_prefix: 0x0F' tag.
